payload.text: ST0010, devbin public (vc claims it). devbin 0.1.15 is released and devbin's L1 is complete (decision 77). Draft ACs AC-S1 to AC-S4 and AC-1 to AC-12. Q1 to Q7 to hv with vc's recs: Q1 ship VERSION, .gitignore, .gitattributes and design/, leave out usage-rules.md, .intent_critic.yml and .prettierignore; Q2 the first public version is 0.1.16; Q3 CI on a candidate branch of the public repository before the tag; Q4 the tap public as it stands after both reads; Q5 keep Intent, Molt and Utilz, and make hv's non-public project names neutral in main with a guard; Q6 ship the notes after Q5; Q7 each release publishes one snapshot. NEXT, on hv's approval and answers: the ACs go in with intent ac new, and the publication work (the safety config, the snapshot builder, the CI change, the name scrub) joins plan item D.
